description: This file defines configuration functions for Vitest testing framework, specifically for voice call extensions, and exports a default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables or defaults to an environment variable 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE'.

methods.name: export function createExtensionVoiceCallVitestConfig( createExtensionVoiceCallVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest configuration object tailored for extension voice call tests, using environment patterns and default settings.
